Key Takeaways

  • Projects above the notified size must be registered with TG-RERA before they can be marketed or sold.
  • A valid RERA registration means declared plans, timelines and an escrow discipline you can hold the builder to.
  • We verify the project's RERA number, status, approved details and the agent's registration.
  • Booking in an unregistered project strips you of RERA's buyer protections.
  • Essential before any apartment or plotted-development booking in Hyderabad.

RERA was created to protect buyers from delayed, mis-sold and diverted projects. But the protection only applies if the project is genuinely registered — and builders sometimes quote a number that is expired, for a different phase, or simply invalid.

JaaGa verifies the builder's and project's TG-RERA status so you know your booking sits inside RERA's protections, not outside them.

When You Need RERA Verification

Before booking any under-construction apartment or plotted development, and before paying a token or booking amount.

Whenever a builder is slow to share the RERA number, or an agent is involved in the transaction.

How We Verify RERA

  1. 1

    Collect Project Details

    We take the project name, builder name and the RERA number provided to you.

  2. 2

    Registry Check

    We verify the number against the TG-RERA registry and confirm it matches the project and phase.

  3. 3

    Review Declarations

    We check approved plans, declared completion timeline, and registered project details.

  4. 4

    Report

    You receive confirmation of valid/invalid registration plus any red flags in the declarations.

Documents Required

  • Project name and builder name
  • RERA number provided by the builder/agent
  • Brochure or booking form (if available)
  • Agent name (if a broker is involved)

Common Problems We Solve

Expired or wrong-phase number

A number may be valid for another phase or lapsed. We confirm it matches your specific unit's project.

Unregistered agents

Agents must also be RERA-registered. We check the broker's status too.

Timeline vs reality

We surface declared completion dates so you can hold the builder to them.

Why RERA Certificate Verification Matters

RERA is only a shield if the project is actually registered. Verifying the certificate before booking is how you keep access to RERA's timelines, disclosures and complaint mechanism — instead of discovering, after paying, that you have none of them.

Frequently Asked Questions

What is TG-RERA?

The Telangana Real Estate Regulatory Authority, with which qualifying real estate projects and agents must register.

How do I know a RERA number is genuine?

It must be verifiable on the TG-RERA registry and match the exact project and phase you are booking. We confirm this for you.

Do agents need RERA registration?

Yes — real estate agents must be registered. We verify the agent's status as well as the project's.

Is a completed project registered?

Requirements differ for completed vs under-construction projects; for ongoing projects registration is mandatory. We advise based on the project's stage.

Can you check before I pay a token?

Yes, and you should verify before any payment. Share the details and we confirm quickly.
